pi-done.description: Wake Hermes when a delegated Pi coding task completes
pi-done.prompt:
Pi coding task {task_id} finished. status={status} cwd={cwd} model={model}. Pi reported: {result_text}

Do this now: verify the result yourself before telling anyone it worked. Read the files Pi claims it changed, and run the relevant test or build command. Pi's own summary is a self-report, never evidence. If verification fails, re-delegate via the pi-bridge with the failure included. Then reply to the user in one or two lines: what changed, what you verified, and anything still broken.

pi-status.description: Live status heartbeat from the Pi bridge (direct delivery, no agent run)
